name: wildcard-excluded-far-outer-valid
description: A single-label wildcard SAN (*.com) does not necessarily fall inside a deep excluded subtree (foo.example.com); *.com expands to host.com hosts that have no relation to foo.example.com.
references: Go name_constraints_test "subdomain excluded constraints do not preclude far outer wildcard names"
notes: RFC 5280 does not define wildcard SAN semantics; this targets Go's application DNS-ID name-constraint behavior.
